fee_notes: Full Franchise: $85,000; Associate Franchise: $42,500. Discounts available: 10% for qualified US veterans/first responders ($38,250 Associate, $76,500 Full); 20% for current franchisees purchasing additional ($34,000 Associate, $68,000 Full); former franchisees may have fee reduced or waived. All fees nonrefundable.
raw_excerpt: The initial franchise fee for a Full Franchise is $85,000, which is payable in a lump sum when you sign the Franchise Agreement and is nonrefundable. The initial franchise fee for an Associate Franchise is $42,500, which is payable in a lump sum when you sign the Franchise Agreement and is nonrefundable.
